title: AudioTETRIS: Token Elimination via Transitional Importance Signals for Efficient Audio LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.13600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on speech-text tasks, but standard audio encoders produce hundreds of tokens for even short audio clips. Because self-attention scales quadratically in sequence length, this inflates inference-time compute substantially. Current training-free token compression methods prune or merge tokens based solely on coarse attention or feature similarity. However, treating audio tokens as generic, isotropic features smooths over spectral transitions, destroying fine-grained phonetic transitions essential for decoding speech. In contrast, speech signals exhibit highly structured temporal patterns where information density peaks at acoustic transitions. We propose AudioTETRIS, a training-free, two-stage framework that uses the audio encoder's representation geometry as an acoustic prior for token importance before applying attention-based compression. translated_title: AudioTETRIS：通过过渡重要性信号进行token消除的高效音频大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在语音-文本任务上表现出色，但标准音频编码器即使对短音频片段也会生成数百个token。由于自注意力的计算量随序列长度呈二次方增长，这大幅增加了推理时的计算开销。当前无需训练的token压缩方法仅基于粗略的注意力或特征相似度来剪枝或合并token。然而，将音频token视为通用的各向同性特征会平滑掉频谱过渡，从而破坏对语音解码至关重要的细粒度语音过渡信息。相比之下，语音信号表现出高度结构化的时间模式，其信息密度在声学过渡处达到峰值。我们提出AudioTETRIS，这是一个无需训练的两阶段框架，在应用基于注意力的压缩之前，利用音频编码器的表示几何结构作为token重要性的声学先验……
tldr: 提出AudioTETRIS，一个无需训练的两阶段token压缩框架，利用音频编码器的表示几何作为声学先验，识别声学过渡处信息密度峰值的关键token，在保留细粒度语音过渡信息的同时大幅降低音频大语言模型的推理计算开销。
